profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: I am a DevSecOps engineer with over three years of experience. I am seeking to transition into full stack and backend software engineering roles, leveraging my knowledge in secure coding practices and system architectures.

positions.title: DevSecOps Engineer
positions.description:
- Oversaw SAST (Static Application Security Testing) and DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing) scanning tools
- Engineered RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) automation to adjust user permissions for scan access
- Managed on-premises environments (Dev, Preprod, Prod) to ensure seamless deployment and testing
- Replaced legacy end to end testing systems with the Cypress JS framework for uniform testing and maintainability
- Developed Python web scraper with multithreading to analyze company domains and target unscanned web servers
- Leveraged knowledge: Python, JavaScript, Git, Docker, AWS, SQL, Cypress, REST APIs, JSON, D3.js, SDLC

positions.title: Information Security Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Constructed UI & API automated testing using the Cypress JS framework to assess the web portals of 3 internal tools
- Developed a Python CLI application to concurrently test the API functionality of a SAST system
- Implemented a JavaScript synthetic monitor to poll the functionality of SAST scans for quick alerts of failures
- Leveraged knowledge: Python, JavaScript, Git, Selenium Webdriver, Cypress, REST APIs, SDLC

positions.title: SSD Technical Intern & Software Tools Intern
positions.description:
- Resolved customer issues by updating over 500 SSDs and writing Python scripts to automate the process
- Developed a CLI tool to automate and simplify the process of adding new product support for non-technical teams
- Assisted in the front-end design and development for a new drive management software to be used by consumers
- Leveraged knowledge: Python, Linux, Git, C#, Adobe XD, Computer Assembly

positions.title: I.T. Student Consultant
positions.description:
- Built a tool integrating Selenium Webdriver to automate processes in the UW ServiceNow notification system
- Provided Tier 1 tech support and troubleshooting for login issues related to University accounts, emails, and applets
- Leveraged knowledge: Selenium Webdriver, Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Chrome Developer Tools
